props.name: direction
props.description: Flow direction. Layout.Flex only. Use Horizontal or Vertical unless you need a reversed direction.

values.name: row
values.whenToNotUse: Use Layout.Horizontal instead. Flex row has no default gap.

values.name: column
values.whenToNotUse: Use Layout.Vertical instead. Flex column has no default gap.

values.name: row-reverse
values.whenToUse: A reversed row. The reason to use Layout.Flex.

values.name: column-reverse
values.whenToUse: A reversed column. The reason to use Layout.Flex.

props.name: align
props.description: Cross-axis alignment, on Flex and Grid. Pass center on a row of mixed-height items, such as a label beside a control.

props.name: justify
props.description: Main-axis distribution, on Flex and Grid. Use between to push two groups apart in a toolbar.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Wrapping. Layout.Flex, Horizontal and Vertical only. A wrapping row also needs gapY, or the wrapped lines touch.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between children on both axes. Horizontal and Vertical default to md. Flex and Grid default to none, so always pass it. Use gap or gapX/gapY, never both. Don't put a gap in className.

values.name: none
values.whenToUse: Flush on purpose. Pass it explicitly on Flex and Grid so the intent is visible.

props.name: gapX
props.description: Horizontal gap only. Use instead of gap, never with it.

values.name: none
values.whenToUse: Flush on purpose. Pass it explicitly on Flex and Grid so the intent is visible.

props.name: gapY
props.description: Vertical gap only. Use instead of gap, never with it. Required on a wrapping row.

values.name: none
values.whenToUse: Flush on purpose. Pass it explicitly on Flex and Grid so the intent is visible.

props.name: grow
props.description: Lets the container fill remaining space. Layout.Flex, Horizontal and Vertical only.

props.name: columns
props.description: Grid column template. Layout.Grid only. A number gives that many equal columns. For a string, use rem or fr, not px. For a responsive gallery use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(16rem, 1fr)).

props.name: rows
props.description: Grid row template. Layout.Grid only. Same rules as columns.

props.name: as
props.description: The element to render, such as 'section' or 'ul', or a component.

props.name: className
props.description: Positioning, sizing and overflow only. Layout emits none of these. Never a gap.
